recommendations.title: Dollar spot risk is building
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 12%, approaching the 20% threshold. Reduce leaf wetness duration where you can (mow or brush off dew early, avoid evening irrigation) and monitor daily.

recommendations.title: Microdochium patch risk is building
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 2/4. Conditions are turning favourable for the disease — increase monitoring frequency, especially after the next rain.

recommendations.title: Too windy to spray today
recommendations.message: Wind is forecast up to 19 km/h, above the typical safe spraying range — drift risk is elevated. Wait for calmer conditions.

recommendations.title: Dew expected tomorrow morning — remove it early
recommendations.message: Forecast temperature and dew point are within 1.2°C of each other in the early hours, so a heavy dew is likely — and microdochium risk is already 2/4. Switching, brushing or an early mow to knock dew off is the single most effective cultural control while disease pressure is elevated.

recommendations.title: Water balance is in a healthy range
recommendations.message: 7-day net balance is -5mm — no irrigation action needed today.

recommendations.title: Soil is warming towards a seeding window
recommendations.message: Soil temperature is 7.7°C, approaching the germination threshold (8°C) for most cool-season UK turf species.

recommendations.title: Growth potential is very low today
recommendations.message: Today's growth potential is 10% of maximum (temperature-limited). Little top growth is expected — hold off on nitrogen and ease mowing right back.

recommendations.title: Nitrogen guidance (growth-potential scaled)
recommendations.message: Average growth potential over the last 30 days is 50%, suggesting roughly 12 kg N/ha this month (= 50% of the 25 kg/ha peak-growth ceiling). Feed only what growth can use — and if the site is in a Nitrate Vulnerable Zone, check the closed-period panel on the dashboard before applying manufactured nitrogen.
